Title: Opposed Pair: E & T
Description: Learn the two fundamental Morse elements: a single dot and a single dash.

Title: Opposed Pair: I & M
Description: Learn double-dot and double-dash characters.

Title: Opposed Pair: A & N
Description: Learn the two possible arrangements of one dot and one dash.

Title: Opposed Pair: R & K
Description: Learn contrasting three-element patterns built from alternating dots and dashes.

Title: Opposed Pair: S & O
Description: Learn the pure three-dot and three-dash characters.

Title: Contrast Pair: U & D
Description: Learn the three-element characters formed by extending I and N with an opposite ending.

Title: Contrast Pair: W & G
Description: Learn the complementary three-element patterns with two dashes and one dot.

Title: Structural Pair: H & B
Description: Learn four-element characters beginning with three dots, and three dots preceded by a dash.

Title: Structural Pair: F & L
Description: Learn four-element characters that extend familiar alternating and dot-heavy patterns.

Title: Structural Pair: V & X
Description: Learn four-element characters beginning with three dots or a dash followed by two dots.

Title: Contrast Pair: J & Z
Description: Learn the four-element characters with three repeated elements followed by their opposite.

Title: Contrast Pair: Y & Q
Description: Learn the four-element characters with three dashes or a dash-heavy alternating pattern.

Title: Remaining Pair: C & P
Description: Learn the remaining common four-element alphabet characters.

Title: Final Letter: X, if needed
Description: Reserved for adaptive practice or a final review of easily confused four-element characters.

Title: Numbers: 5 & 0
Description: Learn the two extremes of the five-element number family: five dots and five dashes.

Title: Numbers: 4 & 9
Description: Extend the five-element number pattern by changing one element from the extremes.

Title: Numbers: 3 & 8
Description: Continue the symmetric five-element number family.

Title: Numbers: 2 & 7
Description: Continue the five-element number family toward the center.

Title: Numbers: 1 & 6
Description: Complete the main numeric family with the two remaining digits.

Title: Punctuation: Question & Period
Description: Learn two high-value punctuation marks with strongly recognizable alternating patterns.

Title: Punctuation: Comma & Colon
Description: Learn two common punctuation characters built from grouped dots and dashes.

Title: Punctuation: Slash & Hyphen
Description: Learn two common characters used in dates, fractions, callsigns, ranges, and compound words.

Title: Punctuation: Parentheses
Description: Learn the Morse patterns used for parentheses.

Title: Punctuation: Apostrophe & Quote
Description: Learn punctuation marks built around dot-and-dash structures.

Title: Punctuation: Equals & Plus
Description: Learn two compact mathematical and formatting symbols.

Title: Punctuation: Ampersand & Underscore
Description: Learn two less frequent but useful symbols.

Title: Punctuation: Exclamation & At
Description: Learn modern communication symbols used frequently in digital text.

Title: Punctuation: Dollar Sign
Description: Learn the Morse code for the dollar sign and other currency notation.

Title: Prosigns: AR & SK
Description: Learn common procedural signals used to indicate the end of a message or contact.

Title: Prosigns: BT & AS
Description: Learn common procedural signals for a break and a wait.

Title: Prosigns: KN & SN
Description: Learn procedural signals used for directed transmission and understanding.

Title: Emergency & Error Signals
Description: Learn internationally recognized and widely used special signals.
